heroHeadline: Saudi Arabia Signs Defense Deal With Syria as Missile and Drone Interceptions Continue
heroSubtitle: Riyadh and Damascus signed a defense cooperation agreement on Nov 4, while the coalition reported intercepting two ballistic missiles over Najran on Nov 6 amid worsening hostilities with the Houthis since July.
